response.original_title: Moonshine Movies Presents AV:X.06 - Mixmasters Episode Three
response.overview: Moonshine Movies presents another Addictive TV production: Audiovisual mind food from the people behind "Transambient" and "Spaced Out."  The Mixmasters DVD series fuses the best in DJ mixes supplied by the coolest independent record lables, with the visual mixes from the worlds top VJs and visual crews.  Episode 3 contains your Audio Visual Xperience with another six exclusive DJ mixes, featuring 23 tracks from artists including Mescalito, DMX Krew and Bonobo, all mindfully fused with eclectic visuals. Musical styles range from electro and chill-out to drum & bass and trance.
